primary_objective: Land the spacecraft on the landing pad at (0,0) as fast as possible with minimal fuel consumption.
objective_decomposition: Phase 1: Descent and horizontal alignment - use main engine (action 2) to control descent rate and orientation engines (actions 1,3) to center over pad.
Phase 2: Final approach - reduce vertical speed, maintain upright angle, both legs contact pad simultaneously.
Phase 3: Landing - zero velocity, upright angle, both legs grounded, terminate with success.
behavior_trajectory_alignment: Phase 1: Descent and horizontal alignment - use main engine (action 2) to control descent rate and orientation engines (actions 1,3) to center over pad.
Phase 2: Final approach - reduce vertical speed, maintain upright angle, both legs contact pad simultaneously.
Phase 3: Landing - zero velocity, upright angle, both legs grounded, terminate with success.
metric_priority: Success rate (landing on pad with both legs, upright, low velocity) and average fuel consumption per successful landing.
primary_selection_metric: Success rate (landing on pad with both legs, upright, low velocity) and average fuel consumption per successful landing.
success_criteria: Both legs ground contact (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1).
Lander is awake and not crashed.
failure_modes: Hovering indefinitely at high altitude using main engine (wastes fuel, no progress).
Landing far from pad (outside pad) but not crashing - satisfies 'not crash' but misses primary objective.
Excessive use of orientation engines causing oscillation or wasted fuel.
Landing with high vertical velocity but both legs contact - may be unstable.
bad_local_optima: Hovering indefinitely at high altitude using main engine (wastes fuel, no progress).
Landing far from pad (outside pad) but not crashing - satisfies 'not crash' but misses primary objective.
Excessive use of orientation engines causing oscillation or wasted fuel.
Landing with high vertical velocity but both legs contact - may be unstable.
reward_generator_constraints: Reward must encourage landing on pad (x,y near 0) with low velocity and upright angle.
Penalize fuel consumption (m_power) to minimize usage.
Provide shaping reward for progress: e.g., reducing distance to pad, reducing speed, improving angle.
Avoid strong penalty for orientation engine use as it is necessary for control.
Terminal reward for successful landing should be large to offset sparse success.
Crash and out-of-bounds should give strong negative reward.
Do not penalize hovering too harshly if it is part of controlled descent.
